lines.text: You're home alone... when something falls over downstairs.
You grab your phone, and go down to check.
But something is peeking around the door frame... from the ceiling.
It crawls toward you, upside down.
You run upstairs, and lock your door.
Then it taps on your door. Softly.
Its long fingers slide under the gap.
It only crawls on the ceiling, and it never looks down.
You have two options. Hide under your bed... or climb out the window, onto the roof.
Comment A or B, and follow, so you don't miss the next night.
